name: Abadía (Spain)
description: Two equal vertical stripes, red at the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Abadía (a bridge on chequy), and chequy of white and blue in three by five at the fly.
history: The arms and the flag of Abadía were approved by the Order of 1 April 1993 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 6 April 1993, after the administrative files were approved on 3 December 1992; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, composed of two equal vertical stripes, red at the hoist with the municipal arms and chequy of white and blue of three by five at the fly.

features.role: chequy of three by five at the fly
